adminDatabase.title: Database editor
adminDatabase.copy: Typed records only. Raw SQL and internal SQLite tables are unavailable.
adminDatabase.bypassCopy: Use normal admin actions whenever possible. Every direct change requires a reason, diff review, typed confirmation, and rescue backup.
adminDatabase.appliedCopy: Rescue backup {id} was created before the mutation.

adminBackups.title: Backups
adminBackups.copy: Verified SQLite snapshots are retained for seven days.
adminBackups.reauthenticate: Reauthenticate if your previous session no longer exists.
adminBackups.reconnect: The app will reconnect after restart.
adminBackups.noneHint: The daily scheduler will create the first verified copy.
adminBackups.deleteDescription: The verified file and its metadata are removed together. Deletion is blocked while a restore is staging or restarting.
adminBackups.jobsHint: Outbox retries and scheduled entitlement changes.
adminBackups.noJobsHint: Scheduled work and retries will appear here.
adminBackups.deleteJobDescription: Pending, completed, and failed work may be removed. A currently processing job remains protected.

databaseRecord.title: {action} {table} row
databaseRecord.copy: Direct edits bypass domain synchronization hooks.
databaseRecord.warning: Every direct mutation is high risk and creates a rescue backup.
databaseRecord.deleteHint: The reviewed diff must show the full row removal before apply.
databaseRecord.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this direct edit necessary?

restoreBackup.title: Stage database restore?
restoreBackup.copy: A rescue backup is created first. The service then restarts and reconnects on the selected verified snapshot.
